references.text: Command to tear down idols and smash them into pieces, the same command regarding the destruction of pagan cult objects.
Command to tear down altars, break the pillars, and cut down Asherah poles, identical language concerning the destruction of idolatry.
Command to drive out the inhabitants, destroy all cast images, and tear down the high places, the same theme of cleansing the land.
Parallel command to tear down altars, break the pillars, cut down Asherah poles, and burn the carved images.
Command to burn the carved images with fire, a direct parallel to the burning of the Asherah poles.
Gideon tears down Ba'al's altar and cuts down the Asherah pole, a practical fulfillment of this command.
King Hezekiah removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah pole, carrying out this command.
King Josiah broke the pillars and cut down the Asherah poles, fulfilling the command to destroy idolatry.
King Asa removed foreign altars and high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles.
The people broke the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and tore down the high places and altars, a comprehensive fulfillment of the command.
King Josiah tore down Ba'al's altars and cut down the sun pillars; the carved images were broken, an action parallel to Deuteronomy's command.
